setup.subject: Subject
setup.noSections: No sections this year. Add sections in Setup first.
setup.noSubjects: This class has no subjects. Add them in Setup → Subjects.
setup.marksHint: Each subject's parts (creative, MCQ, practical, 1st/2nd paper) with full and pass marks. New exams copy them.
setup.partsHint: Exams that have no marks for this subject yet will copy these parts.
setup.teachersHint: Who enters each subject's marks, section by section. A teacher enters marks only for their own subjects and sections.
setup.assignClassTeacher: Give every subject to the class teacher, {name}
setup.choicesHint: Which elective-pool subjects each student takes, and which one is their 4th subject. A subject not chosen is not taken.
setup.noPool: This class has no subjects in the elective pool.
setup.bulkTitle: For the whole section at once
setup.roomsHint: Benches in rows × columns. You pick rooms from here when you seat an exam.
setup.deleteRoomBody: A room used in an exam's seat plan cannot be deleted; switch it off instead.
setup.noRoomsHint: Add rooms to make seat plans and show seats on admit cards.
setup.tooManySeats: At most 500 seats in a room
setup.roundingModeHint: For 79.5%: exact gives A, rounding half up gives A+.
setup.bonusAboveHint: NCTB: 2.00. Leave empty for no 4th-subject bonus.
setup.gpaRoundingHint: For 4.958: truncate gives 4.95, round half up gives 4.96. Below 5 never shows as 5.00.
setup.failZero: A fail in any compulsory subject makes the GPA 0 (F)
setup.failZeroHint: The NCTB rule. Off: a failed subject only counts 0 points.

setupPanel.classesHint: Classes can be added after the exam opens; one with marks cannot be removed.
setupPanel.subjectsHint: The routine's date and time, and this exam's parts and pass marks.
setupPanel.chooseHint: Pick the subjects that are examined. Their parts and pass marks are copied from the subject setup.
setupPanel.subjectDialogHint: Once marks are entered, the parts and full marks are fixed; the date and time can still change.

ruleHint.PER_COMPONENT: Each part needs its own pass mark; failing one part fails the subject.
ruleHint.COMBINED: Parts of the same kind are added across papers (1st paper CQ + 2nd paper CQ) and checked against one combined pass mark. Absent in any part fails.

students.title: Students
students.hint: The list taken when the exam opened. Sync it after admissions or section changes.
students.notOpen: The student list is made when the exam opens.
students.syncHint: New admissions are added, students who left are withdrawn (their marks stay but are left out of results), and section changes are followed.
students.seatsHint: Classes alternate column by column, so no one sits beside a classmate.
students.allocateHint: Choose the rooms. Any earlier seat plan is replaced.
students.noRooms: No rooms in use. Add them in Setup → Rooms.
